headline: Bomb blast at Barishal District Judge Court premises
summary: A loud explosion was heard on Wednesday morning, prompting an immediate response from court police and security forces.
details: A bomb blast occurred within the premises of the Barishal District and Sessions Judge Court on Wednesday morning.
According to court police, the incident took place around 10:45 AM, causing immediate alarm among those present.
Witnesses reported hearing a sudden and loud explosion, which quickly drew the attention of court police and other security personnel to the scene.
Police, RAB, and senior administration officials visited the site to inspect the area and conduct an investigation.
Authorities have not yet identified the individuals responsible for the blast, and investigations are ongoing to determine the cause and nature of the incident.

headline: 680 dead as measles situation spirals out of control in Bangladesh
summary: A Prothom Alo investigation reveals that negligence in vaccine procurement and administration led to a deadly measles surge, with 92% of deceased children unvaccinated.
details: A devastating surge in measles has left 680 people dead in Bangladesh, according to an investigation by Prothom Alo. The report highlights a critical failure in the country's healthcare system, stating that the situation has spiraled out of control due to systemic negligence.

The investigation found that 92% of the children who died from measles had not received any vaccination. This gap in immunization has turned a previously controlled disease into a national health crisis.

Between 2023 and 2025, the procurement of measles vaccines was 42% lower than the actual requirement. The report notes that priority was shifted toward typhoid vaccinations, leaving measles prevention severely underfunded and under-resourced.

Despite early warning signs of an outbreak, responsible officials failed to take necessary precautions. Furthermore, a national campaign held in April and May failed to reach a significant number of children.

The data shows a sharp rise in confirmed cases over the recent years, culminating in a massive spike of 17,385 cases recorded between March 15 and August 2026. This surge underscores the catastrophic impact of the vaccine shortage.
caption:
680 dead and 92% of deceased children were unvaccinated. A major investigation reveals how negligence fueled Bangladesh's measles crisis.

A devastating surge in measles has left 680 people dead in Bangladesh, according to an investigation by Prothom Alo. The report highlights a critical failure in the country's healthcare system, stating that the situation has spiraled out of control due to systemic negligence.

The investigation found that 92% of the children who died from measles had not received any vaccination. This gap in immunization has turned a previously controlled disease into a national health crisis.

Between 2023 and 2025, the procurement of measles vaccines was 42% lower than the actual requirement. The report notes that priority was shifted toward typhoid vaccinations, leaving measles prevention severely underfunded and under-resourced.

Despite early warning signs of an outbreak, responsible officials failed to take necessary precautions. Furthermore, a national campaign held in April and May failed to reach a significant number of children.

The data shows a sharp rise in confirmed cases over the recent years, culminating in a massive spike of 17,385 cases recorded between March 15 and August 2026. This surge underscores the catastrophic impact of the vaccine shortage.
